name: cache-key-classification-folding
body:
Provenance and reconciliation for the classification-config-in-cache-key change-set.

PROVENANCE. The fix previously landed at commit `cbb2cd69` ("fold classification config into the scan cache key") and was reverted by `d68c1c07` as out-of-scope for the apg-cleanup refactor-only change-set ("handed to a separate project"). Recovered from `cbb2cd69` and adapted to the decomposed layout: the original patch touched `src/cache.rs`, `src/cache/tests.rs`, `src/lib.rs`; the layout has since been decomposed, so it now maps to `src/cache/manifest.rs`, `src/cache/tests.rs`, `src/scan.rs`.

RECONCILIATION. `domain.value.cache-key` is named by code doc-comments — `rust.apg.cache`'s module docs, `rust.apg.cache.manifest.CacheKey`'s doc, and `rust.apg.frontends`' `--cache-key` hand-off doc — but was NOT materialized as a node. This change-set materializes it, with the classification-config component added, and attaches it under `domain.group.graph-identity` (the identity umbrella whose realisation is `solution.component.scan-driver`, the component that computes the key). `realised-by` cannot originate from a Value (the SPEC §3.3 matrix at `src/layers/validate.rs` allows only group/entity/service), so the value's realisation is its group's existing `realised-by` edge to `solution.component.scan-driver`; `implemented-by` edges from that component target the existing key code (`rust.apg.cache.manifest.ScanConfigKey`, `rust.apg.cache.manifest.CacheKey.compute`) plus the existing `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan` construction site. [autonomous]

The new requirement drives `domain.value.cache-key` only, not `domain.group.graph-identity`: driving the group would pull the whole of `solution.component.scan-driver` into the verify gate's derived solution coverage and force every one of its unrelated `implemented-by` targets to be touched by a task. [autonomous]

SIBLING, NOT DUPLICATED. The scan blacklist is NOT folded into the cache key — a separate known limitation documented in `requirements.note.blacklist-not-in-cache-key`, explicitly out of scope here. The two are separate gaps in the same key.

PLANNED (not yet in the graph, so deliberately NOT `implemented-by` targets): the plan-writer declares `rust.apg.cache.manifest.classification_digest` and `rust.apg.cache.manifest.classification_render` as planned nodes.
